place.en: Chending Temple · The gate · the stone wall

setup.zh: 二试，脑子：一面石壁，刻着九个空格，一堆刻了数的石块。「横竖斜，加起来都要一样。」
setup.en: Second trial, wits: a stone wall carved with nine empty squares, a heap of numbered stones. "Across, down, corner to corner — they all add up the same."

recap.zh: 二试，洛书九宫：你想起娘教的口诀，「五居中央」。
recap.en: Second trial, the Luo Shu square: you remembered Mother's rhyme — "five in the middle."

en: A stone wall, nine empty squares.
"Across, down, corner to corner — all the same."

story.zh:
**二试 · 脑子。**

一面石壁，刻着九个空格。旁边一堆刻了数字的石块。

**扫地的老头**：横竖斜，加起来都要一样。

几百个孩子围着石壁，抓耳挠腮。有人把石块摆成了一朵花。有人把石块摞成了一座塔。有一个孩子，把石块全部塞进了嘴里——你到现在也不知道他在想什么。

你看着那九个格子。

你想起灶间的那盏油灯。你娘教你认字的时候，也教你算账；教你算账的时候，教过你一个口诀——

戴九履一，左三右七，二四为肩，六八为足，五居中央。

她说，是她爹教她的。她爹，是从一本旧书上看来的。
story.en:
**Second trial · Brains.**

A stone wall carved with nine empty squares. Beside it, a heap of stones carved with numbers.

**The old sweeper:** Across, down and corner to corner — they must all add up the same.

Hundreds of children crowd round the wall, scratching their heads. Someone arranges the stones into a flower. Someone stacks them into a tower. One child stuffs every stone into his mouth — to this day you don't know what he was thinking.

You look at the nine squares.

You remember the oil lamp in the kitchen. When your mother taught you your characters, she taught you accounts too; and when she taught you accounts, she taught you a rhyme —

Nine on the head, one at the feet; three on the left, seven on the right; two and four the shoulders, six and eight the feet; five in the middle.

She said her father taught it to her. Her father had it from an old book.

exits.means: hands in the solved square, or asks to go on to the third trial

refuse.zh: 九宫还没填满。瞿老不看半张卷子。
refuse.en: The square is not filled yet. Elder Qu does not look at half an answer.

story.zh:
你把五，放在了正中间。

{伴·洛书}
story.en:
You put the five right in the middle.

{伴·洛书}
